rationale: Iran-US escalation threatens energy prices for Portugal; Ceuta assault crisis continues in neighboring Spanish territory; fast fashion fees may affect Portuguese consumers.

top_events.title: Iran retaliates after US strikes kills four at wedding party, state media reports
